command:
cd /Users/dct/code/EllyaOrg/projects/dalimaray/observatory-wt/current/scripts/contract-checks && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('lib.sh').read()
old=s[s.index('# The commits a branch adds'):]
new='''# The commit a check judges. GitHub checks out a pull_request as a synthetic merge commit (refs/pull/N/merge) that
# carries no trailer and hides the branch behind it; the branch is its second parent.
head_ref() {
  if [ "${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME:-}" = pull_request ] && git rev-parse --verify -q 'HEAD^2' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    git rev-parse 'HEAD^2'
  else
    git rev-parse HEAD
  fi
}
# The commits a branch adds: from the merge base with the mission branch, or from the pinned baseline when the head is
# the mission branch itself.
range_base() {
  m=$(mission_ref) || return 1
  h=$(head_ref)
  b=$(git merge-base "$m" "$h" 2> /dev/null) || return 1
  if [ "$b" = "$h" ]; then
    pin=$(cat "$(dirname "$0")/git-baseline.txt" 2> /dev/null)
    if [ -n "$pin" ] && git merge-base --is-ancestor "$pin" "$h" 2> /dev/null; then
      b=$pin
    fi
  fi
  echo "$b"
}
'''
open('lib.sh','w').write(s.replace(old,new))
def sub(f,a,b):
    t=open(f).read(); assert a in t,(f,a); open(f,'w').write(t.replace(a,b))
sub('g6-commit-format.sh','"$base..HEAD"','"$base..$(head_ref)"')
sub('g5-metrics-untouched.sh','"$base" HEAD --','"$base" "$(head_ref)" --')
sub('g6-shared-files.sh','[ "$base" != "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ]','[ "$base" != "$(head_ref)" ]')
sub('g6-shared-files.sh','"$base..HEAD" --','"$base..$(head_ref)" --')
sub('g6-shared-files.sh','git diff "$base" HEAD --','git diff "$base" "$(head_ref)" --')
sub('g7-ci-run.sh','gh run list -R "$REPO" --commit','gh run list -R "$REPO" --workflow mission-branch.yml --event push --commit')
sub('exceptions.txt','(m4-demo-gate-and-branches)\ng6-shared-files aa56596','(m4-demo-gate-workflow)\ng6-shared-files aa56596')
sub('exceptions.txt','D-040 and its index row (m4-demo-gate-and-branches)','D-040 and its index row (m4-demo-branch-and-ruleset)')
EOF
git diff --stat; git diff exceptions.txt g5-metrics-untouched.sh g6-shared-files.sh; grep -rn "HEAD" *.sh | grep -v "^lib.sh"
